info.title: HomeHub
info.description: Self-hosted family wall-calendar and chores. /api/v1 routes need a bearer token unless the server runs with HOMEHUB_TRUST_NETWORK=1.

bearerAuth.description: API token created with `pnpm cli token create <name>`.

timezone.description: IANA timezone, e.g. Europe/Berlin. All display uses it.

initial.description: Defaults to the first letter of the name.

weekMode.description: rolling = 7 days starting today; fixed = week per household weekStart.

idleReturnMinutes.description: Idle minutes before returning to today's Week view; 0 disables.

keepAwake.description: Request the screen wake lock while the app is visible.

defaultWriteCalendarId.description: Member id → default calendar id for new events (null = none).
